item.title: YAF Lawsuit Targets Federal Rule Used to Justify DEI in Many Federal Programs
item.description: YAF's latest legal action targets the regulation that gives federal officials justification for race-based and unconstitutional DEI practices in more than 100 government programs.

item.title: Fall YAF Poll Reveals Young Voters' Views on Political Violence, Free Speech
item.description: When it comes to young voters’ opinion on including strongly conservative viewpoints in the marketplace of ideas, 31 percent believe things are better when such views are kept out of the public square, including 53 percent of young liberal voters.

item.title: YAF Launches Expanded 'Freedom at 250' Partnership With The Daily Wire
item.description: This year-long, nationwide tour of programs and activities will bring The Daily Wire’s juggernaut media brand, legendary mainstay talent, and rising stars together with YAF’s six decades of experience shaping America’s future
